# Orthodox Church of St. Euphrosyne in Białystok

## Basic Information

The Church of St. Euphrosyne (Polish: *Cerkiew św. Eufrozyny*) is an Eastern Orthodox church located in Białystok, Poland. It belongs to the Polish Autocephalous Orthodox Church, which has a significant presence in the Podlaskie region of northeastern Poland.

## Patron Saint

The church is dedicated to **St. Euphrosyne of Polotsk** (c. 1101-1167), a medieval Belarusian princess who became a nun and is one of the most venerated saints in the Orthodox tradition of Belarus and the broader Eastern Slavic world.

## Location and Context

Białystok has historically been a multicultural city with a notable Orthodox Christian population, largely due to its proximity to Belarus and its history under various administrations (Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Russian Empire, etc.).
